data.gender_notes: Alfeus is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word ἄλφεος, meaning 'noble' or 'man of noble birth'. In Greek mythology, Alfios was a river god. The name Alfeus carries the meaning “Man of noble birth” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alfeus usually hope their child will grow to embody man of noble birth and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alfeus total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
